recipe.visualDefinition: A high-contrast, grainy black-and-white close-up portrait of a man with thick black glasses, paired with bold, bright red stencil-style typography that overlaps the subject's forehead and fills the upper right negative space.
coreVisualRelationships: Red typography against a grayscale photographic background
Tight cropping on the subject's face creating intimacy and intensity
Industrial stencil texture contrasting with organic facial features
Diagonal eye-path from the subject's gaze to the stacked text blocks
coreInvariants: Vibrant red (#FF0000) for all text elements
Grainy, desaturated black and white photography

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Subject is positioned on the left two-thirds of the frame, scaled to a tight head-and-shoulders crop.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The dark, thick frames of the subject's glasses.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the eyes, moves up to the primary header text, then drops to the secondary text block on the right.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Neutral gray background on the right side provides a canvas for the secondary text.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value contrast between the red text and the gray background; low saturation except for the text.

letterConstructionRules: Horizontal stencil breaks in the middle of vertical stems
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single typeface family used in two distinct blocks with varying alignment.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the heavy slab-serif stencil aesthetic
Captures the retro-industrial feel of the era

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a grainy, high-contrast black and white portrait of a man with thick black glasses looking slightly upward, with a neutral gray studio background and a tight crop.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Apply bold red stencil slab-serif text in all caps. Place the primary name across the top left, overlapping the hair. Place a two-line secondary phrase in the upper right negative space, right-aligned.

verificationChecks: Are the stencil breaks clearly visible?
Does the text overlap the subject's hair?

mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the original person
postGenerationChecks: Ensure the red text does not have a digital glow.
Check that the stencil bridges are consistent across all letters.
Verify the photo grain looks like film, not digital noise.
Confirm the composition feels 'top-heavy' as per the original.
recipe.reuseFormula: Take a high-contrast B&W portrait + Add heavy red stencil type + Crop tightly to the eyes = New Wave Aesthetic.
